description.zh: 用可见轮廓标记当前键盘焦点位置，让用户知道下一个按键会落在哪里。鼠标点击往往不需要它，但键盘与辅助技术用户必须始终看见焦点在哪，否则只能盲操作。通常用 :focus-visible 控制——键盘聚焦才显示，鼠标点击不打扰。
description.en: A visible outline marking the currently focused element, so users know where the next keystroke will land. Pointer users rarely need it, but keyboard and assistive-tech users must always see focus or they are operating blind. Usually driven by :focus-visible — shown for keyboard focus, silent for mouse clicks.

use_when.zh: 任何可聚焦元素（按钮、链接、输入框、自定义控件）
use_when.en: Any focusable element — buttons, links, inputs, custom widgets

use_when.zh: 用 :focus-visible 而非 :focus，避免鼠标点击也弹框
use_when.en: Targeting :focus-visible rather than :focus so clicks stay clean

use_when.zh: 自定义控件覆盖了浏览器默认轮廓之后
use_when.en: After custom styles have overridden the browser default outline

avoid_when.zh: outline: none 之后不给任何替代指示（键盘用户直接失联）
avoid_when.en: Removing outline: none without a replacement indicator

avoid_when.zh: 把焦点环做成 hover 高亮的复制品，只在鼠标下可见
avoid_when.en: Cloning the hover highlight so focus is only visible to the pointer

avoid_when.zh: 焦点环对比度不足 3:1，或被邻近元素裁切遮挡
avoid_when.en: Rings below 3:1 contrast, or clipped by neighbouring elements

disambiguation.zh: 焦点环不等于 hover 高亮——焦点环服务键盘用户，hover 服务指针用户。
disambiguation.en: A focus ring is not a hover highlight — focus serves keyboard users, hover serves pointer users.

note.zh: hover-glow 是鼠标悬停的装饰反馈，焦点环是键盘可达性的必需指示。
note.en: hover-glow is decorative pointer feedback; a focus ring is required keyboard affordance.

note.zh: outline + outline-offset，最通用、可被 forced-colors 保留
note.en: outline plus outline-offset — universal, survives forced-colors

note.zh: box-shadow 双层描边，圆角跟随元素形状
note.en: Layered box-shadow ring that hugs custom border-radius

note.zh: 只变边框色，视觉最弱，需配合加粗才够用
note.en: Border-color only — weakest, needs a weight bump to pass

notes.zh: 基础写法：:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }。需要跟随圆角时改用 box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px 两层环。覆盖浏览器默认轮廓后必须提供替代；forced-colors 模式下保留 outline。可用 :focus:not(:focus-visible) 精确去掉鼠标点击的环。
notes.en: Base recipe: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }`. Switch to a two-layer `box-shadow` ring when you need it to hug custom radii. Never drop the default outline without a replacement; keep outline under forced-colors. Use `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` to strip click-only rings precisely.

basic.zh: 给项目里的按钮和链接加上清晰的键盘焦点环，Tab 切换时能看见当前位置。
basic.en: Add a clear keyboard focus ring to buttons and links so Tab navigation is always visible.

design.zh: 所有可聚焦元素显示 2px 强调色外轮廓，offset 3px，与圆角一致；鼠标点击不显示，键盘聚焦才显示；深浅色主题下对比度均不低于 3:1。
design.en: Every focusable shows a 2px accent outline at 3px offset matching its radius; visible on keyboard focus only; at least 3:1 contrast in both light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 全局：:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }；禁止裸写 outline:none；自定义圆角组件用 box-shadow 环替代；:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none } 去掉点击环。
implementation.en: Global: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }`; never ship bare outline:none; use a box-shadow ring for custom radii; `:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none }` strips click rings.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现可见键盘焦点环。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- :focus-visible 显示 2px 强调色轮廓，offset 3px，鼠标点击不显示
- 全项目禁止无替代的 outline: none
- 自定义圆角组件用 box-shadow 环跟随形状
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a visible keyboard focus ring in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- :focus-visible shows a 2px accent outline at 3px offset; mouse clicks do not
- No bare outline: none anywhere without a replacement
- Custom-radius components use a shape-hugging box-shadow ring
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.
